parts.name: box_body
parts.geometry_hint: hollow thin-wall box shell, ~6mm wall, open at the top

parts.name: box_lid
parts.geometry_hint: thin rectangular panel matching the body footprint; small recessed thumb notch folded into the front edge

joints.name: lid_hinge
joints.origin_hint: along the rear top edge of the body (the hinge line), not the lid center
joints.opens: free edge lifts upward/away from the body (positive q opens the lid)

dynamics_intent.feel: the opened lid should remain where the user leaves it

acceptance: the lid opens upward to at least 90 degrees so the interior is accessible
the lid closes flush onto the body without intersecting it
the lid stays attached to the body at the rear hinge across its full range of motion
